fixture.origin: Original Android Store/worker pending checkpoint, copied as Base64 only into test source

scope: Independent SketchHost public SDK semantic XCTest only: raw prepare counts, no reservation, state recheck, pending identity, test-only Foundation atomic write/read receipt, retained pending retirement and new-session single commit. Previous 11 consumer cases also ran, with the pending case strengthened for sameContent value equality versus handoff identity. No ordinary GUI, production IO/durability, physical stylus/heap, final public SDK approval or C1 freeze. New reader cases explicitly check malformed/unsupported typed refusal pairs and no capability conversion. Canonical codec is used solely for trusted unsupported fixture setup; it is not approved as an arbitrary-input read API.
